related_questions.question: Can I take COVID tests on a plane?
related_questions.snippet: Passengers may also bring hand wipes through checkpoints. Unused COVID-19 test kits do not contain dangerous goods and are typically allowed in both carry-on and checked baggage. COVID-19 test kits containing diagnostic samples (e.g., nasal swabs and vials of sputum) are not allowed in carry-on baggage.
